title: Uqrat tan ixxigah ayfaf yacee
intro: Qur'aanak fidin xaagih addat, yallih ixxigaa kee racmattah yan Yallih taama abeena soolah yan. Tama mistirih yan num, kaxxa nabiyyittek numuk teyna luk gitat gexak, seehadayti baxi edde geytimam wagsiisak, sissin abtootat kibbimte safar fanah gexe. Kulli abto, qadli sinna celta way, sarrimaanaay, sabrii kee qibaadah amriik derret tan ambulle wayta wale wagsiisak adda xer qasiiritte qellissa. Ta iraawoh muuci miyyaay, kee manni numma oson yuybulleenim?
clues: Anu Yallih taama abeynak sugeeh, baxsale ixxigaa kee racmatta doorime.
kaxxa nabiyyi yok bartam faxak sugeeh, anu diggale caalatal oggoleh.
ni koboxih uddur, anu sidiica abto xayyoyseh too yi wakliitih qadli sinnim celta.
Anu baacoytitih tan huuri finqiseh, uxih qeltut tan racmattak sugte.
Anu qunxa awkih mano beeh, qangiino lem celta way, kay xaleenah rooka catoonuh sugte.
Anu gidaar qagitaak xiseh magaalal qibnaytiino nek cinteh, gubal tan gadda baxxaqisak.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Namma badih angaarawal yallih farmoyti muusa yangooroweenim
Goog kee Maagog qagitak adaf xisaanama
trial.answer: Namma badih angaarawal yallih farmoyti muusa yangooroweenim

outcome.label: Xalu
options: usuk baxxaaqiseh qibaadah wale derret kaak badit tan abtoota kee gititte baxsimteh Muusa lih
Usug safarak lakal nabiinu geeh yan
Usug qibnaytiino sinni magaalal masjid xise.
outcome.answer: usuk baxxaaqiseh qibaadah wale derret kaak badit tan abtoota kee gititte baxsimteh Muusa lih

arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا
verse: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge. (18:65)
